title: The Thing
synopsis: An Antarctic research station, a Norwegian helicopter, and a thing that imitates anything it touches.

nodes.text: A helicopter hunts a dog across white tundra with a rifle.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Take cover.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.

nodes.text: The husky comes in calm, eyes too bright.

nodes.text: You sit across from Childs with a flask between you and you watch each other for tells while the fire dies, and you wait for the dawn or the end.
You both come up clean. The next research team finds you sleeping back-to-back in the wreckage.
One of you is wrong. The other one doesn't know it yet. The wind takes the bottle. The story does not end.
